name: Terminal Experience
description: Lets a person work with the AI from a plain terminal: converse with the hub line by line, or watch any harness live, with each step and helper in place, Escape to stop and keep the session, resume, a correction shown as sent and taken up, a risky step waiting for y or n, the structure of the work as lines, and the closing report.
purpose: Let a person converse with the hub and watch, stop, resume and steer the AI from a plain terminal, with any harness.
approach: Draw the session's events as text in place on a terminal (plain lines elsewhere) and read keys and lines back as the session's controls, with no UI library.
out_of_scope: The contract of events and controls and the harness adapters (AI Session Experience), plain data for a separate frontend (Frontend Interface), choosing which structure to show and what is inside it (Structure In View), how a run is answered (the front door), and a consumer's own screen.
milestones: 1. The requirements of docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md that a scripted session can show are met on the hub's loop and on a stream session (authoritative metric metric-terminal-session).
knowledge: Placement against siblings: the other two children draw the same events for something that is not a terminal (Frontend Interface) or decide what structure is worth showing (Structure In View); the terminal is the reference surface, so it keeps the existing code and the existing scripted metric, and its arms compete on keys, redraw and the line REPL baseline. Compared with Claude Code, Codex CLI, opencode, Aider and others on 2026-11-10 (registry area terminal_agent_experience).
measures_of_success: Share of scripted sessions right: every typed line reaches the front door, stop then resume loses nothing, a steer is taken up in the next call and shown, helpers show with their parent, a risky step waits, the same script passes on two harnesses.
inputs: A harness (start and control), a goal, a text stream, optional key source; or lines and a front door for converse.
outputs: The text written, and a SessionReport (last Finished, every run, all events, the controls and whether each was taken); for the structure, plain lines.
effects: Runs the harness in a thread, reads keys (Escape, Ctrl-C, lines), writes to the stream it is given, and redraws in place only on a terminal.
usage_notes: Contract: hubofhubs/the_consciousness/ai_session_experience/session_events.py. Demo with no model: python -m hubofhubs.the_consciousness.ai_session_experience.terminal_experience.live --demo loop. Requirements and research: docs/explanation/working-with-the-ai-while-it-works.md.
change_driver: how people want to talk to the hub from a terminal
